name: iaigiri
rendering: Literal BMA diffuse applied once over white converter vertex colors as bounded unlit palette mapping. Native leaf light0/NORMAL, ambient/specular and global DS lighting are not recreated.

converter.playback: Original SDK integer-frame tables, not converter60fps clips/quaternion interpolation

renderer.limitation: Native sequence/sample emulator render; not a DS hardware/DAC/shared-channel capture. Browser cry gain(120/127)*(100/127) is a linear presentation mapping, not the DS logarithmic mixer/ADSR hardware path.
